data.evidence: Current acceptance uses original project-authored fixtures. It does not establish full official-data or runtime compatibility.
data.execution: Read explicit local input files; replay changes in-memory own state only. No game DLL loading, game execution or network access.
supported: ARZ v3 selected record with finite fields
Own inventory-cycle fixture: task start/update, existing-item take/add, events, money and reward history
unsupported: Other archive/quest versions or unknown decoder types
Native object construction/destruction, live engine state
Rendering, input, combat, playable game, saves and original-save compatibility
